session_token_data_classification.title: Session Token Data Classification Level
session_token_data_classification.description: The formal data classification tier assigned to session tokens in the organization's data governance policy or data dictionary. Also governs whether encryption-at-rest and masking requirements apply to memory artifacts and storage.

field_level_encryption_enforced_for_toke.title: Field-Level Encryption Enforced for Session Tokens
field_level_encryption_enforced_for_toke.description: Whether field-level encryption is applied to session token storage (database columns, cache entries, etc.) as required by the classification policy.

token_masking_in_logs_enabled.title: Session Token Masking Applied in Logs
token_masking_in_logs_enabled.description: Whether session tokens are masked, redacted, or filtered in all logging outputs (application logs, access logs, audit logs, middleware, WAF/proxy) to prevent plaintext exposure.

token_access_audit_logging_enabled.title: Strict Access Audit Logging Enabled for Token Operations
token_access_audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether all read/write access to session token stores triggers strict audit log entries with user identity, timestamp, and operation type, as expected for confidential-tier data.

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days that application or audit logs are retained before deletion or archival. If this exceeds the maximum session token lifetime, tokens are exposed beyond their functional validity period.

max_session_token_lifetime_days.title: Maximum Session Token Lifetime (Days)
max_session_token_lifetime_days.description: The maximum lifetime of a session token in days, as configured in the identity/session management system. Used to determine whether log retention exceeds the token's functional validity window.

log_scope_includes_session_tokens.title: Log Scope Includes Session Token Fields
log_scope_includes_session_tokens.description: Whether the application logs fields that contain or could contain session token values, such as HTTP Authorization headers, Cookie headers, session ID fields, or raw request/response bodies.

memory_snapshot_scrubbing_enabled.title: Memory Snapshot Token Scrubbing Enabled
memory_snapshot_scrubbing_enabled.description: Indicates whether the application scrubs or masks session tokens from heap dumps, core dumps, and crash reports before they are persisted or transmitted.

crash_report_destination.title: Crash Report Destination
crash_report_destination.description: Where crash reports and core dumps are sent — local disk, external service (e.g., Sentry, Crashlytics), or discarded. External destinations amplify exposure risk.

token_store_rbac_enabled.title: Token Store RBAC Enabled
token_store_rbac_enabled.description: Whether role-based access control is enforced at the data level on the in-memory cache or temporary store holding active session tokens, restricting which processes or users can read token entries.

token_store_access_scope.title: Token Store Access Scope
token_store_access_scope.description: The breadth of access granted to the token store — whether it is restricted to the owning service only, shared among multiple services, or accessible to any authenticated user or process on the host.

token_enumeration_commands_restricted.title: Token Enumeration Commands Restricted
token_enumeration_commands_restricted.description: Whether bulk enumeration commands (e.g., KEYS *, SCAN, smembers on a session set) are blocked or require elevated privileges on the token store, preventing mass token harvesting.

server_side_token_invalidation_on_logout.title: Server-Side Token Invalidation on Logout
server_side_token_invalidation_on_logout.description: Whether the application explicitly invalidates (blacklists or removes) session tokens on the server side when a user logs out, times out, or is revoked.

token_overwrite_on_disposal.title: Token Value Overwritten or Zeroed on Disposal
token_overwrite_on_disposal.description: Whether the token value is explicitly overwritten (zeroed or replaced) in memory and storage media upon session termination, preventing recovery from memory dumps or cache reads.

token_logged_in_plaintext.title: Token Logged in Plaintext
token_logged_in_plaintext.description: Whether session token values appear in plaintext in application logs, access logs, or audit trails, creating a persistent post-session exposure vector.

token_classified_as_personal_data.title: Session Token Classified as Personal Data or Authentication Credential
token_classified_as_personal_data.description: Indicates whether session tokens have been formally classified as personal data or authentication credentials under applicable jurisdictional law (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), triggering data transfer restrictions.

cross_region_replication_enabled.title: Cross-Region Token Replication Enabled
cross_region_replication_enabled.description: Whether session tokens are actively replicated to cache nodes, analytics pipelines, or storage systems located in jurisdictions different from the originating region.

data_transfer_agreement_status.title: Data Transfer Agreement Status
data_transfer_agreement_status.description: The status of applicable cross-border data transfer agreements (e.g., SCCs, BCRs, adequacy decisions) covering the jurisdictions to which session tokens are transferred.
